nom: COSRX Red Rice Pore Peel Shot

avis.titre: Not my favorite peel, but did produce results.
avis.texte: I've tried several peel shot products, starting with Dr. Melaxin and several other Korean made brands, so I knew what to expect but was hoping this would exceed my expectations for the price point. The packaging and design is great and I liked that Niacinimde was specifically called out, as this is an important active for me in my daily routine and I look for it in most cosmetics. I was disappointed, first in myself that I took it for face value without inspecting before purchase, then in the ingredient listing that it was nearly at the bottom. This product wasn't a great source of niacinimide compared to other alternatives. The peel was slow to form but did have decent results. Rinsing and removing all of the product and dead skin was more difficult than other brands, however. It creates a drag or like a friction on the skin which makes it difficult to really remove everything without adding more products for lubrication or further exfoliation. All in all, its not horrible but not one that I will purchase a second time over other peels.

At first I was a little hesitant to purchase product due to higher price point compared to some competitor products but based on those reviews decided to splurge and try the COSRX version. The product has small volume but a little goes a long way, so I'm happy with the value. Upon using I immediately noticed a difference in gentle exfoliation of face and pore cleansing. I tried product on other areas of body and did not find results and peel action to work as well as on face, so I am saving exclusively for face use in future. I do not use this daily but whenever face feels like it needs a deep refresh it really does the trick at removing outer dead skin layer instantly and opening up pores for cleansing. Despite higher price point I will be continuing to buy in future.

avis.titre: Skin type is important with this product!
avis.texte: Normal, combo, or dry skin: This stuff is amazing! I have combo skin with a little bit of rosacea and this exfoliates without irritating my face at all! It comes out of the bottle like a serum and as you rub it on your face, it pills up and exfoliates. Oily skin: Doesn’t seem to work at all. My husband has oily skin and I tried it on him a couple times. I think the natural oiliness of his face combines with the serum, so the product isn’t able to pill up the way it should.

avis.titre: If you’re face is peeling, this is a must
avis.texte: I’m taking a prescription retinoid and it makes my face peel. I’ve tried scrubs, which are too harsh on my skin, I’ve tried different washcloths and still, I’m peeling, but I used this and it is gentle on my sensitive skin and is so effective exfoliating!!
Love this product!! Skin is super soft after using! It’s amazing how much dead skin is removed by this product. Definitely feel my skin texture is improving since using. Great value!
This is a great product. Took all the dead skin off my face the first time I used it and it did it gently. No abrasive scrubbing. Will purchase again and again!
I like how this immediately gets the dead skin off. Also super gentle on the skin
Tolles Peeling . Ich hatte schon nach der ersten Anwendungen eine deutlich schönere Haut. Mach 14 Tagen, feinere Poren und weniger Hautunreinheiten! Ich werde es wieder kaufen!

Ive got sensitive skin and this product is gentle on the skin. It makes my face SOOO smooth. I tried it on my fiance as well and he loved how smooth his face was afterwards. Just make sure you moisturise after <3

avis.titre: Suitable for sensitive skin, gentle but effective exfoliation
avis.texte: I have sensitive, rosacea prone skin that, due to changes in hormones, has become quite oily. I decided to try this exfoliating pore peel serum to try to keep my pores clean and reduce oiliness. I use a lot of COSRX products and it's a brand that I trust. The serum arrived in quite a large bottle with a dropper. After washing my face, I dropped a few drops on my hands and applied it to my face. The serum dries very quickly so you need to work fast if you want to cover your entire face. I focused mainly on my T-zone areas, working the serum in and rubbing gently. It was quite incredible to see the dead skin rolling off my face as I rubbed. Once I rinsed my face, it felt noticeably softer and smoother. It did leave a weird sticky feeling on my skin but that disappeared by the next day. I think this serum really works, but I would recommend anyone with sensitive skin to go slowly. I will only be using this once a week as I'm afraid of damaging my skin barrier, but will try to work up to twice a week if my skin can tolerate it.

I've used several other COSRX products recently and liked them all, so I was pleased to be able to give this a try. OH. MY. WORD. I LOVE THIS STUFF. It is supposed to be used as an exfoliator and rinsed off, not as a leave on serum. It comes with a dropper, I've found one full dropper is generally enough for my face. I apply in a thin layer, and rub. It pills up all the dead skin and feels so satisfying, and I've used a very wet cloth to wipe off the remnants afterwards, just because I don't like to put my face straight under the shower (or splash my face in the sink). Skin feels SO SMOOTH after use, its like glass. Probably not supposed to, but I have also used this on the tops of my feet and on my elbows, and its made such a difference. On my face, I've found skincare absorbs more easily after use, and makeup sits much better. Will definitely repurchase, it is a little on the expensive side but its totally worth it.

avis.titre: Mein absolutes Highlight: Peeling-Wunder gegen hartnäckige HautschüppchenMein absolutes Highlight: Peeling-Wunder gegen
avis.texte: Ein extrem ergiebiges, fast geruchloses Peeling-Serum, das selbst hartnäckigste Hautschüppchen bei Mischhaut mühelos und sanft entfernt. Die sensationelle Wirkung rechtfertigt den Anschaffungspreis vollkommen. Mein absoluter Favorit! Dieser Artikel wurde mir im Rahmen des Amazon Vine Programms zur Verfügung gestellt. Ich bewerte das Produkt jedoch nach bestem Wissen und Gewissen und teile hier meine völlig ungeschönte, persönliche Erfahrung. Ich mache es kurz: Dieses Serum von COSRX in der 80-ml-Flasche ist das beste Produkt, das ich in letzter Zeit testen durfte, und es wird zu 100 % nachgekauft! Meine Poren sind aktuell zwar in einem recht guten Zustand, aber ich kämpfe mit klassischer Mischhaut. Das bedeutet für mich: Unreinheiten auf der einen Seite, aber gleichzeitig extrem trockene Stellen mit hartnäckiger Schuppenbildung, vor allem auf der Nase und den Wangen auf der anderen. Wer das kennt, weiß, wie sehr diese kleinen, fiesen Schüppchen stören, die man gefühlt ständig ungewollt aus dem Augenwinkel wahrnimmt und in denen sich jegliches Make-up das man sich wagt aufzutragen, absetzt. Hier wirkt dieses Serum wirklich wie ein absolutes Wunder. Von der Viskosität her ist es etwas dickflüssiger als Milch, tropft also nicht sofort unkontrolliert weg und lässt sich mit der Glaspipette ganz hervorragend dosieren sowie gezielt auf die Haut auftragen. Wie bei dieser Marke oft üblich, kommt das Produkt nahezu ohne eigenen Geruch aus, was ich als sehr rein und angenehm empfinde. S

avis.titre: CosRx Does It Again - Great Exfoliation for Dry and/or Mature Skin
avis.texte: At 52, post-menopausal, with dry, mature skin, exfoliation is something I have to be very careful with. Too aggressive, and my skin shows it immediately. Too mild, and it doesn’t do enough to make a difference. This landed right in the middle for me. I’ve used peel shots from Dr. Melaxin and Tosowoong, so I went into this with pretty clear expectations. I’ve also had consistently good experiences with COSRX, which is why I was curious to try their version. This feels like a more balanced take on this type of product. It’s not harsh. It doesn’t feel like it’s stripping your skin or pushing it too far. Instead, it gives you that controlled exfoliation that removes buildup and smooths texture without leaving your skin tight or irritated afterward. For mature, dry skin, that matters. The texture and application are easy. It spreads evenly, works quickly, and rinses clean without leaving residue. It layers well into a routine and doesn’t interfere with the rest of my skincare. From an ingredient standpoint, this is focused on gentle exfoliation and skin-smoothing rather than aggressive resurfacing. The rice extract helps support a softer, more even look, while the overall formula is designed to refine texture without compromising the barrier. That balance is what makes it usable on a regular basis. I love Cosrx products, I have been using their products for ages. Especially their acne patches. I also have been having dry skin recent due to the weather changing, so the exfoliation is welcome. I am Korean, and have large pores, blackheads, and comedome acne (it is under the skin, so pimples thanks to clogged pores). My skin is generally oily and still is to a point. But the recent dryness is a thing. Usually, I use a peel shot exfoliator, it never occured to me that it could be in anything else. It looks like a standard serum and exfoliator with the eyedropper tool and all that. It might be cause I am sick while testing this, but it took me a moment to figure out if it is a serum and you put it on like a serum... or like a peel shot exfoliator. It is on the box, but I was still not entirely sure since anything you apply is generally after washing your face. I used it as an exfoliating peel. It is extremely lightweight and does feel more like a serum than a peel, but I was right in choosing. The exfoliation is very gentle and the fermented rice (and rice grains and rice water) have brightening properties. There aren't any rice bits in there, if you were wondering. The size is large, and it is easy on the skin. Overall, I do recommend this product for anyone who is looking for gentle but effective exfoliation. I'm giving it 2 stars because it cut part of my nose. I'll continue using it carefully to see if it works and then I'll update…

Cosrx red rice Inositol Is an exfoliating care & pore peel serum. I have tried several cosrx products and this one is by far my favorite. The serum is gentle & exfoliating which helps to reduce blackheads and weight heads. It also contributes to a more refined skin texture. With ingredients such as niacinamide plus aha + PHA plus vitamin B5 it is a skin care packed formula. Unfortunately, the ingredients are not listed on the bottle. I noticed no fragrance but can't confirm without the ingredient list. The bottle includes a dropper style applicator. Bottle is a good size for the price. After washing, using a good amount, slightly massage the product into your face. After massaging for a minute, you'll notice the product starts granulating and removing Gunk from your pores while exfoliating the surface. I've tried several different color rice products like this, although I don't notice a difference between the rice color. If you're looking for one of these, this one is a good one to try!

First of all let me just say that I love Cosrx products! This one is no exception. I usually use at night after I take my makeup off and wash my face with cleanser. I feel like this exfoliating serum gives my skin an extra cleanse to make sure all the makeup is completely wiped off. It doesn’t feel rough on the skin and I haven’t had any breakouts from it. I’ve only used it for about a week so it’s too soon to see visible results but I do feel like the skin on my face is a lot more clean now and it makes the makeup application the next morning a lot easier.
